title: rsi divergence and bollinger bands on gold… trying to automate it onchain
author: beachisbest29
selftext:
i’ve been watching gold for a while now since fed signaled rates are going to stay higher for longer .sentiment swings are hard on every cpi print and then the mean reverts . been building around that for a few months now .

the setup is rsi divergence on the 4 hours combinedd with a 20 day bollinger band squeeze . when gold streches two deviations outside the band and rsi is showing divergence on the last 3 candle is my entry signal . i tried to keep it as simple . did some backtest and i feel these parameters are right  for the current macro environment.

i wanted to automate it and tried it with the broker apis first. it had a lot of compliance forms and a couple of documents required . they responded after around 10 days asking for more document scans . pretty annoying tbh

did some research and only a few names . not a lot of options exists , integrated with one sdk coz the access was immediate and the execution goes onchain  but the pricing comes from tradfi markets . i can also audit every fill after the fact which matters as im trying to figure out if the strategyy is working or if execution is a problem

the integration part took less time then i expected but i think the indicator work is going to take some more time before i increase my position sizee

im still running it the rate volatility around fed decisions is making the signal , big extensions are happening outside the band . the rsi divergence is catching the turns with the mean reversion following it

still unsure on the strategy and tweaking the parameters every now and then . anyone working in the similar kinda setup and what infra you all are using??
